mapper.sql: SELECT a.*,p.title AS place_title,ho.display_name AS operator_name FROM activity_bookings a LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id=a.place_ref_id LEFT JOIN host_organizations ho ON ho.id=a.host_organization_id

SELECT o.*,a.title AS activity_title,s.starts_at AS slot_starts_at,s.ends_at AS slot_ends_at,s.timezone AS slot_timezone FROM activity_orders o JOIN activity_bookings a ON a.id=o.activity_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_slots s ON s.id=o.slot_id
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_bookings SET url=#{url},redirect_url=#{redirectUrl},activity_type=#{activityType},title=#{title},description=#{description},activity_address=#{activityAddress}, departing_from=#{departingFrom},destinations=#{destinations}::jsonb,destination_coordinates=#{destinationCoordinates}::jsonb, search_lat=#{searchLat},search_lng=#{searchLng},destinations_norm=#{destinationsNorm},navigation_list=#{navigationList}::jsonb, itinerary_stops=#{itineraryStops}::jsonb,pickup_addresses=#{pickupAddresses}::jsonb,price_amount=#{priceAmount},price_currency=#{priceCurrency}, duration_raw=#{durationRaw},duration_hours=#{durationHours},visit_duration_minutes=#{visitDurationMinutes},languages=#{languages}::jsonb, meeting_point=#{meetingPoint},included_items=#{includedItems}::jsonb,excluded_items=#{excludedItems}::jsonb,eligibility=#{eligibility}::jsonb, accessibility_features=#{accessibilityFeatures}::jsonb,confirmation_type=#{confirmationType},voucher_type=#{voucherType}, redemption_instructions=#{redemptionInstructions},cancellation_policy=#{cancellationPolicy}::jsonb,required_information=#{requiredInformation}::jsonb,thumbnail=#{thumbnail}, images=#{images}::jsonb,highlights=#{highlights}::jsonb,what_to_expect=#{whatToExpect}::jsonb,itinerary=#{itinerary}::jsonb,good_to_know=#{goodToKnow}::jsonb,faqs=#{faqs}::jsonb,video_url=#{videoUrl},product_status=#{productStatus}, data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND host_organization_id=#{organizationId} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: WHERE a.id=#{id}

JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=a.host_organization_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.host_organization_id IS NOT NULL AND a.product_status='ENABLED' AND a.inventory_mode='INTERNAL' AND o.operational_status='ENABLED' AND o.verification_status='VERIFIED' AND (a.place_ref_id IS NULL OR p.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE')
WHERE a.host_organization_id=#{organizationId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_packages SET code=#{code},name=#{name},description=#{description},currency=#{currency},base_price=#{basePrice},original_price=#{originalPrice},package_group=#{packageGroup},group_type=#{groupType},departure_type=#{departureType},details=#{details}::jsonb,min_quantity=#{minQuantity},max_quantity=#{maxQuantity},inventory_type=#{inventoryType},units=#{units}::jsonb,included_items=#{includedItems}::jsonb,excluded_items=#{excludedItems}::jsonb,required_information=#{requiredInformation}::jsonb,confirmation_type=#{confirmationType},voucher_type=#{voucherType},validity_days=#{validityDays},attributes=#{attributes}::jsonb,cancellation_policy=#{cancellationPolicy}::jsonb,status=#{status},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_packages WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM activity_packages WHERE activity_booking_id=#{activityId} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_slots SET starts_at=#{startsAt},ends_at=#{endsAt},timezone=#{timezone},capacity=#{capacity},blocked_quantity=#{blockedQuantity},booking_cutoff_minutes=#{bookingCutoffMinutes},price_override=#{priceOverride},unit_prices=#{unitPrices}::jsonb,all_day=#{allDay},meeting_point_override=#{meetingPointOverride},status=#{status},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion} AND reserved_quantity+sold_quantity+#{blockedQuantity}<=#{capacity}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*,(capacity-reserved_quantity-sold_quantity-blocked_quantity) AS available_quantity FROM activity_slots s WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT s.*,(capacity-reserved_quantity-sold_quantity-blocked_quantity) AS available_quantity FROM activity_slots s WHERE package_id=#{packageId} AND starts_at>=#{from} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY starts_at
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_slots SET reserved_quantity=reserved_quantity+#{quantity},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ENABLED' AND starts_at>(#{now}+booking_cutoff_minutes*interval '1 minute') AND reserved_quantity+sold_quantity+blocked_quantity+#{quantity}<=capacity

UPDATE activity_slots SET reserved_quantity=reserved_quantity-#{quantity},sold_quantity=sold_quantity+#{quantity},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND reserved_quantity>=#{quantity}

UPDATE activity_slots SET reserved_quantity=reserved_quantity-CASE WHEN #{fromReserved} THEN #{quantity} ELSE 0 END,sold_quantity=sold_quantity-CASE WHEN #{fromReserved} THEN 0 ELSE #{quantity} END,data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND ((#{fromReserved} AND reserved_quantity>=#{quantity}) OR (NOT #{fromReserved} AND sold_quantity>=#{quantity}))

WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
WHERE o.order_status='PENDING_PARTNER_CONFIRMATION' AND o.hold_expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY o.hold_expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT i.*,p.name AS package_name FROM activity_order_items i JOIN activity_packages p ON p.id=i.package_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId}
WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_orders o
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_orders WHERE slot_id=#{slotId} AND order_status IN ('PENDING_PARTNER_CONFIRMATION','CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN')
WHERE o.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND o.voucher_code=#{voucherCode}

UPDATE activity_orders SET voucher_code=#{voucherCode},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND voucher_code IS NULL
UPDATE activity_orders SET redemption_status='VOIDED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND voucher_code IS NOT NULL AND redemption_status='NOT_REDEEMED'

UPDATE activity_orders SET order_status='EXPIRED',data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND order_status='PENDING_PARTNER_CONFIRMATION' AND data_version=#{expectedVersion} AND hold_expires_at<=#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_orders o WHERE o.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND o.order_status=#{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_orders o JOIN activity_slots s ON s.id=o.slot_id WHERE o.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND o.order_status IN ('CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN') AND CAST(s.starts_at AS date)=#{day}
